name: habits-build-tracker
description: Science-backed habit and skill tracker PWA

scripts.start: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run start:shared" "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @habits-tracker/shared && npm run build -w @habits-tracker/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @habits-tracker/shared && npm run build -w @habits-tracker/api
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @habits-tracker/shared && npm run build -w @habits-tracker/web && npm run build -w @habits-tracker/api
